systematic_missing_reason: The imagery provider gives no local orientation accuracy or masonry restoration survey. Digitizing uncertainty is conditional on identifying the ancient face.

notes: We selected western and southern fortification faces in the protocol. The full current mosaic was inspected first; vegetation obscures the masonry. We used archived release 8432, where the faces are clearer. This source choice is exploratory.
